items.title: 68190_Samuel
items.q: Well, as I understand it, the band was in Denver and Bill Saunders, the great tenor saxophone player, with whom we've all played at one time or another or who has played with us, brought Benny back to town

ctx.x: I think he would have turned it over to somebody else to perform the tonsillectomy because he loved Benny and Dr. Bruce was a fine physician, he was a fine man. He did like musicians and this is the last thing in the world that he would have wanted to happen to Benny Mother but I guess it was just -- I guess this could have happened if he hadn't been out the night before. It's just one of those things that happened.

Well, as I understand it, the band was in Denver and Bill Saunders, the great tenor saxophone player, with whom we've all played at one time or another or who has played with us, brought Benny back to town for that operation.
